correctness.rationale: PASS: The claim applies to the coefficientwise Fermat quartic over every odd prime field, rational NS ranks only, and only the specified 48 classical lines (not 112 in p=3). Rebuilt its line-incidence matrix from three displayed congruences; independent rational elimination gives rank 20 and degree 14 on 48 labels, and Frobenius orbit-sum matrix ranks 20,11,8,11 for residues 1,3,5,7. The hyperplane class in the span and the Hodge-index nondegeneracy identify Gram rank with line-span dimension. For p≡1 mod4 the nonzero Hasse invariant forces geometric NS rank at most 20; lines give equality. For p≡3 mod4 the separable Hermitian power cover gives Frob²=p² on H², and #X(Fp)=(p+1)² yields trace 2p and 12/10 (+p/-p) dimensions; the supersingularity criterion and Tate theorem make all 22 classes algebraic. Subtracting line Frobenius multiplicities yields one fixed and one negated missing divisor direction. Finite exact line ranks certify only fixed combinatorics; the all-prime claims require the independent geometric/cohomological steps.
